<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title>Laurie Desroches | Resume Profile</title>
  <meta name="description" content="Resume-style employer profile for Laurie Desroches, based in Summerside, PEI.">
  <meta name="robots" content="noindex,nofollow">
  <style>
    :root {
      --ink: #14273a;
      --muted: #587087;
      --soft: #eef7ff;
      --soft-2: #dceefa;
      --card: rgba(255,255,255,.82);
      --line: #c8deee;
      --accent: #2e6f92;
      --accent-dark: #17445d;
      --accent-soft: rgba(46,111,146,.12);
      --green: #4d7b6d;
      --shadow: 0 18px 42px rgba(20,39,58,.12);
      --radius: 24px;
    }
    * { box-sizing: border-box; }
    body {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--ink);
      background: radial-gradient(circle at top left, rgba(113,177,212,.32), transparent 34rem), radial-gradient(circle at bottom right, rgba(77,123,109,.14), transparent 28rem), linear-gradient(135deg, #f8fcff 0%, var(--soft) 45%, var(--soft-2) 100%);
      font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
      line-height: 1.6;
    }
    a { color: var(--accent-dark); }
    a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(46,111,146,.3); outline-offset: 3px; }
    .skip-link { position:absolute; left:-999px; top:1rem; background:var(--ink); color:#fff; padding:.75rem 1rem; border-radius:999px; z-index:10; }
    .skip-link:focus { left:1rem; }
    .wrap { width:min(1080px, calc(100% - 32px)); margin:0 auto; }
    main { padding: clamp(30px, 6vw, 72px) 0 56px; }
    .hero { display:grid; grid-template-columns:.88fr 1.12fr; gap:clamp(28px,5vw,58px); align-items:center; padding-bottom:34px; }
    .portrait-frame { width:min(360px, 88vw); aspect-ratio:4/5; margin:0 auto; padding:12px; border-radius:999px; background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.95), rgba(236,247,255,.95)); border:1px solid rgba(200,222,238,.95); box-shadow:var(--shadow); overflow:hidden; }
    .portrait-frame img { width:100%; height:100%; display:block; object-fit:cover; object-position:center center; border-radius:999px; }
    h1 { margin:0 0 .7rem; font-size:clamp(2.75rem, 7vw, 5.4rem); line-height:.95; letter-spacing:-.055em; }
    .subtitle { margin:0 0 1rem; color:var(--accent-dark); font-weight:700; font-size:clamp(1.03rem, 2.1vw, 1.25rem); }
    .lead { max-width:650px; font-size:clamp(1.08rem, 2.2vw, 1.32rem); color:#334d63; margin:0 0 1.25rem; }
    .hero-meta { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:.65rem; margin:1.35rem 0 1.6rem; }
    .pill { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:.45rem; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:999px; padding:.55rem .8rem; background:rgba(255,255,255,.66); color:#395b74; font-size:.96rem; }
    .section { margin-top:22px; }
    .grid { display:grid; gap:18px; }
    .grid.two { grid-template-columns:repeat(2, 1fr); }
    .grid.three { grid-template-columns:repeat(3, 1fr); }
    .card { background:var(--card); border:1px solid rgba(200,222,238,.9); border-radius:var(--radius); padding:clamp(20px, 3vw, 28px); box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(20,39,58,.07); backdrop-filter:blur(12px); }
    .card h2, .card h3 { margin-top:0; line-height:1.18; }
    .card h2 { font-size:clamp(1.55rem, 3vw, 2rem); margin-bottom:.7rem; }
    .card h3 { font-size:1.15rem; margin-bottom:.45rem; }
    .card p { margin:.55rem 0 0; color:#36536a; }
    .highlight { border-left:5px solid var(--accent); background:linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-soft), rgba(255,255,255,.76)); }
    .list { list-style:none; padding:0; margin:.8rem 0 0; display:grid; gap:.65rem; }
    .list li { position:relative; padding-left:1.55rem; color:#355169; }
    .list li::before { content:""; position:absolute; left:0; top:.55rem; width:.55rem; height:.55rem; border-radius:50%; background:var(--green); box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(77,123,109,.14); }
    .skills-list { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:.55rem; padding:0; margin:.9rem 0 0; list-style:none; }
    .skills-list li { border:1px solid var(--line); background:rgba(255,255,255,.72); color:#34566e; border-radius:999px; padding:.48rem .72rem; font-size:.94rem; }
    .contact-line { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:.1rem; padding:.9rem 0; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(200,222,238,.9); }
    .contact-line:last-child { border-bottom:0; }
    .label { color:var(--muted); font-weight:700; font-size:.92rem; }
    .value { color:#243f55; }
    footer { padding:0 0 42px; color:var(--muted); font-size:.92rem; }
    @media (max-width:860px) { .hero { grid-template-columns:1fr; } .portrait-frame { width:min(310px,82vw); } .grid.two,.grid.three { grid-template-columns:1fr; } }
    @media (max-width:560px) { .wrap { width:min(100% - 22px,1080px); } .pill { width:100%; justify-content:flex-start; } }
    @media print { body { background:white; color:black; } .skip-link { display:none; } .wrap { width:100%; } main { padding:0; } .hero { grid-template-columns:160px 1fr; gap:24px; padding-bottom:16px; } .portrait-frame { width:160px; box-shadow:none; padding:0; } .card { box-shadow:none; background:white; backdrop-filter:none; } h1 { font-size:40px; } .grid.two,.grid.three { grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; } }
  </style>
</head>
<body>

  </main>
  <footer class="wrap"><p>Last updated June 22, 2026.</p></footer>
